# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'fileutils'
require 'rubygems/package'

module ThemeInstaller
  # Unpack an uploaded theme tarball (an IO) into dest.
  def self.install(io, dest)
    count = 0
    Gem::Package::TarReader.new(io) do |tar|
      tar.each do |entry|
        next unless entry.file?

        target = File.join(dest, entry.full_name)
        FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(target))
        File.binwrite(target, entry.read)
        count += 1
      end
    end
    count
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'stringio'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'theme_installer'

class ThemeInstallerTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_installs_one_file
    io = StringIO.new
    Gem::Package::TarWriter.new(io) { |tar| tar.add_file('a.css', 0o644) { |f| f.write('x') } }
    io.rewind
    Dir.mktmpdir { |dir| assert_equal 1, ThemeInstaller.install(io, dir) }
  end
end
